normalization: Prepend the Rocket mount, remove the declared query portion after ?, and retain path parameters and declared trailing slashes.
deduplication: Do not collapse repeated method/path pairs; each declaration is identified by source file, line, handler, and Rocket rank.
statusPolicy: not_implemented means OneWarden has no corresponding compatible implementation; the /alive, HEAD /alive, and /api/alive contracts are marked compatible only when their database-backed readiness behavior is satisfied.
